class.name: d1max_pct_rviz_tools/Start3D
class.description: 3D Start: directly place/focus a 3D space marker without clicking the point cloud (B).

class.name: d1max_pct_rviz_tools/Goal3D
class.description: 3D Goal: directly place/focus a 3D space marker without clicking the point cloud (N).

class.name: d1max_pct_rviz_tools/PlanningPanel
class.description: Exact XYZ editing, explicit grounding and global path preview. No robot control.

class.name: d1max_pct_rviz_tools/LiveGoal3D
class.description: Create and focus a MoveIt-style XYZ goal in the owned live preview; never a robot command.

class.name: d1max_pct_rviz_tools/NavigationDiagnosticsPanel
class.description: Read-only localization and planning status, color legend and saved views. No robot control.

class.name: d1max_pct_rviz_tools/MotionControlPanel
class.description: Explicit session-bound low-speed execution and stop requests; never connects to the robot SDK.
